purpose: M0/M1/M2/M3/M4/M5 versioned gold-standard manifest skeleton. Fixed SHAs and archive hashes are pinned for reproducibility, but no critical fact or human review has been recorded; this is NOT ground truth yet.

capabilitySlices.note: Import, workspace, parser-unavailable and syntax-error fixtures exist in tests, but no fixed-SHA corpus or human-reviewed critical facts have been added.

Fixture tests cover extensionless/barrel/directory-root imports, tsconfig paths and baseUrl, workspace package names, project references, cycles, external/unresolved separation, AST evidence reconciliation and an independent-denominator mutation test. No fixed-SHA corpus or human-reviewed critical module facts exist yet.

Fixture tests cover go.mod module/replace resolution, go.work workspace use, build-tag/GOOS/GOARCH file selection, standard-library/external/internal-cross-module edge classification, cycles, syntax errors, parser-unavailable degradation, an independent-denominator mutation test and an end-to-end production-dependency check. Fixed Go grammar versions are web-tree-sitter@0.27.2 + tree-sitter-go@0.25.0 (see docs/adr-go-parser.md). No fixed-SHA corpus or human-reviewed critical Go module facts exist yet.

M3 fixtures cover Next re-export/alias, Vite React Router, Go HTTP methods, middleware/factories, computed handlers, dynamic paths, multiple Methods, unresolved handlers and independent-denominator behavior. Fixed-SHA observations are Authelia 101/101, WriteFreely 128/128 and Commerce 1/1 route declarations resolved, with zero unresolved handlers. External unification covers static hosts, object operations, callbacks and process integrations without provider bypass. These observations are not human-reviewed Gold facts.

M4 fixtures cover SQL read/write/transaction/migration, Queue/Worker, channel send/receive, Pub/Sub, ticker schedules, required env without defaults, override defaults, cross-file receiver fields and strict static-host gating. Fixed-SHA observations are Authelia 73/73 and WriteFreely 5/5 async declarations resolved, with CI schedule negatives and zero blocking omissions. WriteAs and GitLab are configured hosts with defaults; Gitea/Generic OAuth are configured protocols; ActivityPub remains dynamic protocol. These observations are not human-reviewed Gold facts.

M5 adds independent view coverage, projection round-trip validation, adapter independence mutations and critical Gold checks. Authelia, WriteFreely and Commerce all pass full-declared-scope with fullArchitecture: true and independencePassed: true. This is per-input semantic completeness only; no human-reviewed critical Gold facts or generator release qualification is claimed.

rules.revision: Every corpus entry must pin a 40-character fixed SHA before any critical fact is added.
rules.criticalFacts: Manually audited only. Never generated by the production detector and then used as its own answer.
rules.metrics: node/edge precision, recall, direction accuracy and evidence validity are reported separately; false positives and false negatives never cancel out.
rules.mutation: Each critical declaration class needs a mutation test with the production extractor disabled.
